about_the_game:
Welcome to the Squirreled Away demo!

This demo offers a comprehensive introduction to the game, allowing players to experience the fundamentals of squirrel life. Explore the starting zone, craft items, and assist your fellow park residents. You can also begin constructing your treetop dwelling in the second zone. Although limited to single-player, save data will be transferable to the full game upon release.

Live the Whimsical Life of a Squirrel

Step into the shoes—or rather, the paws—of a clever squirrel navigating a vibrant urban park in Squirreled Away. Immerse yourself in the pure joy of scampering up towering trees, leaping from branch to branch, and exploring a world bursting with charm and wonder.

Craft, Explore, and Thrive

Leave the survival worries behind and dive into a delightful craft-and-thrive adventure. Forage for unique materials, discover hidden treasures, and use your creativity to build the treehouse of your dreams. Each creation opens new opportunities for fun and exploration, rewarding your curiosity and ingenuity.

Meet the Park's Friendly Denizens

The park is home to a few delightful characters, each with their own stories and quests. Make friends with the park’s charming inhabitants and lend a helping paw. Your kindness and cleverness will unlock even more adventures and surprises.

A Cozy Adventure Awaits

Squirreled Away offers a cozy, heartwarming experience perfect for those who love to unwind and enjoy the simple pleasures of life. The lush, hand-crafted world and soothing soundtrack create a relaxing atmosphere that invites you to explore at your own pace.

Key Features:

  • Pure Squirrel Fun: Experience the joy of being a squirrel with playful, acrobatic movement and dynamic exploration.

  • Craft to Thrive: Gather materials and build a charming treehouse filled with unique decor and make it a home.

  • Friendly Encounters: Meet and help a variety of delightful park residents, each with their own stories and rewards.

Whether you're climbing to the highest treetops or crafting the perfect hideaway, Squirreled Away promises a heartwarming journey full of discovery and delight. Are you ready to get Squirreled Away?

Wishlist now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low graphics settings

short_description: Be the squirrel. Scurry through gardens, up trees, and leap limb to limb in this craft and thrive parklife adventure. Meet and help other residents and collect bits here and there to build and decorate your dream treehouse.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
